changelog: **Matching round review & publish API (#1796, story #1791):** `PATCH /api/admin/match-rounds/[id]/proposals` — `lock | unlock | discard | restore` per row or in bulk (`{ ids, action }`, ≤ 500, guarded `updateMany` on the states each action may come from — `PROPOSAL_ACTIONS` in `round.ts` — with every skipped row reported and why; `lock` needs a mentor) and `swap` (`{ id, mentorId }`, DRAFT rows only): the score is recomputed server-side by the same engine and inputs as the pass (`scoreSwap()`, `roundSwap.ts`, the round's own seat reservations counted against the mentor's capacity); the strict schema refuses a browser-sent score and a blocked pair is 409 with the rule. `POST /api/admin/match-rounds/[id]/publish` (REVIEW rounds only) creates one relation per LOCKED proposal inside ONE transaction through the shared create path now extracted from `POST /api/mentorship` (`src/lib/relationCreate.ts`: `createGuardedRelation()` with the one-active-mentor guard in the transaction, `announceNewRelation()` after the commit — `mentorship.created` webhook, `MatchDecision` with `source = BULK_ROUND`, `roundId` and the proposal's frozen score via the new `snapshot` input of `recordMatchDecision()`, both sides' notices, agreement prompt and mails). The plan cap is checked for all pairs at once (`checkActiveRelationLimit(orgId, n)`) and a refusal or a mentee paired elsewhere meanwhile rolls the whole publish back — never a half-published round. Relations land in the round's cohort. `GET /api/admin/match-rounds/[id]/diagnostics` groups unmatched mentees by reason, names the hard rule that blocked the most pairs (`stats.blockedPairsByRule`, now written by the pass, and `blockedBy` ordered most-eliminating first) and lists skills more unmatched mentees need than mentors with room hold (pure `roundDiagnostics.ts`).
